messages:
carmen: noticing a perf/regression on the latest runtime roll — tail latency spikes on long-prefix requests after the kernel-selector change.  p95 tokens/sec drops ~18% :thinking:
avi: can you paste the profiler traces? is this only on multi-batch or single-stream too?
carmen: mostly multi-batch. attached a short nvprof stack (trimmed):
```
GPU memcpy HtoD  4.3ms
alloc slab  0.8ms  (new)
kernel matmul  2.1ms
free slab  0.9ms
alloc logits 1.2ms
free logits 1.1ms
// note: alloc/free pattern every step for some activations
```

zach: that alloc/free pattern screams fragmentation + allocator churn. did kernel selector change the preferred kernel size causing different temp buffer sizes? :eyes:
maria: yes — selector now prefers tiled kernel for seq>512 which increases scratchpad needs by ~30%. old kernel used persistent workspace that fit our slab bins. new one forces per-call mallocs.
carmen: exact. KV cache growth + tiled kernel = working set doesn't fit contiguous slab bins -> allocator falls back to smaller fragments. profiler shows free-list contention on stream 3.
avi: can you run the mini-repro with POOL_DEBUG=1 and `--alloc-trace`? want the sequence of sizes and slab ids.
carmen: ran it, here's the snippet:
```
[alloc]  size=12.8MB -> slab_id=7
[free ]  size=12.8MB <- slab_id=7
[alloc]  size=18.6MB -> new_chunk(18.6MB)
[alloc]  size=4.2MB -> slab_split(18.6MB -> 14.4+4.2)
[free ]  size=4.2MB -> add_free(4.2MB, bin=4)
[alloc]  size=12.8MB -> cannot find 12.8 in bin -> split 14.4 -> leftover 1.6MB -> fragmentation++
```

zach: fragmented splits like that will cascade. options: coarser slab sizes, enable eager coalescing on free, or prefer older kernel for long-seq workloads.
maria: another lever is sticky-buffering for logits/activations: keep hot tensors pinned per-model variant and reuse across batches when layouts compatible. avoids alloc/free churn but uses reserved pool memory.
avi: what's the KV behavior? if KV cache pins pages while we allocate scratchpads it's worse.
carmen: KV keeps large pinned pages for active sessions. combined with tiled kernel workspace we hit high watermark. The allocator currently does lazy_free at end-of-step which doesn't immediately coalesce.
zach: quick mitigation: change allocator to do eager coalesce on free when fragmentation > threshold. Also tune bin sizes: add a 16MB bin to avoid splitting 18.6MB into awkward pieces.
maria: also add a kernel-affinity hint: prefer kernel variant that fits existing slab alignment. kernel selector can request preferred workspace size and the allocator can try to satisfy that without extra splits.
ci-bot: deploy-preview succeeded for patch branch "orchard-reuse-fix". perf test queued.
avi: for canary, let's patch three things: 1) add 16MB bin, 2) eager_coalesce_when_fragmented=true gated by env, 3) kernel-affinity hint surface in selector API. run 24h perf job.
carmen: I'll prototype the allocator change and add logs. quick snippet for selector hint API:
```
struct KernelHint { size_t preferred_workspace_bytes; bool prefer_persistent_workspace; }
select_kernel(model, seq_len, &hint)
```

zach: nice. add metric: alloc_splits_per_minute and slab_fragmentation_ratio to console so we can correlate with p95.
maria: one more: KV eviction policy — consider spilling cold KV to host pinned memory when GPU high-water marks hit, temporarily reducing GPU pressure.
avi: agreed. action owners: carmen (allocator + logs), zach (metrics + bins), maria (kernel-affinity + KV spill), me (orchestrate canary). Target: canary tomorrow morning.
carmen: ack. I'll post a short repro and the alloc traces in eng-runtime thread when ready. :thumbsup:
